name: Scrying Goggles? No Problem!
label: Quest
description: Scrying Goggles? No Problem!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You just want his scrying goggles? Great! That will be no problem... Just give me a minute to... Hey! Where the... Dagnabbit!

Well, there's some bad news and some worse news. The bad news is that I lost the goggles. The worse news is that I lost them when I was nosing around in the Molten Core last month. Yep, the Molten Core... I guess that concludes our business! Bye!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Molten Core, eh? I hope my goggles are still in one piece!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Outstanding! Now where did I put that 500 pound chicken and Volume II of "Draconic For Dummies???" Oh, and here's a little something for all your hard work!
